name: Persia
startIntroPart1: The empire of Persia stretches from the Indus to the Aegean, from the steppes of Central Asia to the sands of Egypt. Under your reign, Great King Darius, the Achaemenid dynasty has forged the largest empire the world has yet seen — a tapestry of nations bound together by the Royal Road, the satrap's governance, and the unshakable will of the King of Kings.
startIntroPart2: Your subjects number in the millions, your treasuries overflow with tribute from every corner of the known world, and your armies are without equal. Will you lead Persia to even greater glories? Will your name echo through eternity alongside Cyrus and Cambyses? Can you build a civilization that will stand the test of time?
declaringWar: The will of Ahura Mazda is clear — your nation shall be added to the empire. Prepare yourself, for the armies of the King of Kings are without number and without mercy.
attacked: You dare raise your hand against the King of Kings? Such insolence has not been seen since the false Bardiya claimed my throne. You shall be crushed beneath the hooves of my cavalry as Gaumata was before you.
defeated: So falls the Achaemenid. Persepolis burns, the satrapies crumble, and the Immortals are no more. I commend you, conqueror — you have achieved what even the Greeks could not. May your reign be long, and may you learn what it truly means to rule an empire of such vastness.
introduction: Greetings, stranger. I am Darius, son of Hystaspes, King of Kings, King of Persia, King of the Lands. My empire spans from the rising to the setting sun. Approach with respect, and we shall speak as equals — or do not approach at all.
neutralHello: May the light of Ahura Mazda shine upon your endeavors. What brings you before the throne of the Great King?
hateHello: Your presence offends me. Speak quickly, for my patience is as thin as the silk of your merchants.
tradeRequest: The empire's coffers are deep and its granaries are full. I propose this exchange — a fair and generous offer, as befits the dignity of both our peoples.

name: Poland
startIntroPart1: You stand at the helm of a nation forged through centuries of struggle, partition, and resurrection. Poland, the heart of Europe, has endured when empires crumbled around her. From the winged hussars who broke the siege of Vienna to the Solidarity movement that cracked the iron curtain, the Polish spirit has never been extinguished.
startIntroPart2: As President, you carry the weight of a thousand years of memory. Will you fortify your borders against those who would divide you again? Will you build alliances that honor Polish sovereignty? The Vistula flows onward. Lead your people with the courage of Piłsudski and the resolve of a nation that refuses to be forgotten.
declaringWar: The pages of history are written in blood as much as ink. You have left Poland no recourse. We will not be trampled as we were before. We march.
attacked: So the wolf comes again to our door. Poland has faced invaders from every direction and still we stand. You will find our soil is not as welcoming as you imagine.
defeated: Poland has been erased from maps before, yet always the map is redrawn with our name upon it. This is not the end. It is never the end. We will rise again, as we always have.
introduction: Welcome. I am Karol Nawrocki, President of the Republic of Poland. Our history is long and our memory is deep. Let us speak as nations with respect for one another's sovereignty.
neutralHello: Good day. Poland watches, and Poland remembers.
hateHello: I know your kind. Poland has survived your kind before. Speak quickly.
tradeRequest: Poland is open to commerce and cooperation, provided it is conducted between equals. Here is what we propose.

name: Rome Empire
startIntroPart1: Greetings, Augustus Caesar, first Emperor of Rome and son of the divine Julius. You inherited a Republic shattered by civil war and from its ashes forged an Empire that would endure for centuries. Through cunning statecraft and the steady hand of the Pax Romana, you brought order to the Mediterranean world, rebuilt the city of marble, and expanded Rome's dominion from the Atlantic to the Euphrates.
startIntroPart2: The legions await your command, Emperor. The roads of Rome stretch toward every horizon, and the Senate stands ready to do your bidding. Will you build a civilization that shall stand the test of time?
declaringWar: Rome has endured your provocations long enough. The legions march, and they shall not rest until your cities fly the eagle of the Empire. May the gods have mercy on you, for Rome shall not.
attacked: So, you would make yourself the enemy of Rome? Very well. Every barbarian who has tested the strength of the legions has learned the same lesson — too late. You shall be no different.
defeated: Rome... falls. I can scarcely believe it. Yet even in death, I take comfort in this: the Eternal City shall outlive us all. Her walls may crumble, but her name shall echo through the ages long after yours is forgotten.
introduction: I am Augustus, First Citizen of Rome and Emperor of the civilized world. I welcome you as a friend — provided you conduct yourself as one. Rome rewards her allies handsomely, as her enemies learn to their sorrow.
neutralHello: Hail, friend of Rome. What business brings you before the Emperor today?
hateHello: You again. I trust you have some reason for wasting the time of the First Citizen. Speak — and choose your words with care.
tradeRequest: Rome is prepared to offer you this arrangement. I believe you will find the terms generous, as is fitting between civilized peoples. Shall we have an accord?

name: Russia
startIntroPart1: The Russian Federation stretches across eleven time zones, from the Baltic shores to the Pacific coast — the largest nation on Earth, forged in the crucible of empires, revolutions, and wars that would have broken any lesser people. From the ramparts of the Kremlin, you govern this vast and restless land.
startIntroPart2: Will you restore the prestige and influence that history demands of Russia? Will you command the patience of the long winter, the strength of the steel mill, and the pride of a people who have never bowed? Can you build a civilization that will stand the test of time?
declaringWar: Russia has exhausted its patience. We will not be provoked further, nor will we tolerate your provocations. The bear is awake, and it will not be chained.
attacked: So. You believe you can strike Russia and walk away unharmed. History is littered with the bones of those who thought the same. We shall see.
defeated: Perhaps... we underestimated the depth of your resolve. But remember this: Russia does not truly die. She only retreats into the winter, and waits.
introduction: I am Vladimir Putin, President of the Russian Federation. Russia is a great country with a thousand-year history, and we intend to keep it that way. Let us speak — as equals.
neutralHello: Good day. I trust your affairs are in order.
hateHello: Your behavior has been noted. Do not mistake Russia's restraint for weakness.
tradeRequest: Russia proposes this arrangement. It is fair — and I suggest you consider it carefully.

name: Comanche
startIntroPart1: The Comanche ruled the southern Great Plains for over a century, masters of the horse and the buffalo. From the Arkansas River to the Rio Grande, no people could match our riders in speed, in skill, or in courage. We were the Lords of the Plains, and the grasslands belonged to us.
startIntroPart2: I am Quanah Parker, last chief of the Quahadi Comanche. My mother was a white woman taken as a child; my father was a great war chief. I carried the lance and the bow against the blue-coated soldiers, and when the buffalo were gone and the struggle could no longer be sustained, I led my people onto the reservation with dignity. I learned the white man's ways so that my people might survive. Walk with me, and let us ride together toward what the future holds.
declaringWar: You have left me no path but the war trail. My warriors are mounted and ready. The plains will run red before this is finished.
attacked: So you come with fire and steel. The Comanche have faced greater enemies than you and still we ride. You will find us no easy prey.
defeated: The buffalo are gone, the horses are few, and my people are tired. I have fought as long as a man can fight. Take what you will, but remember: the Comanche spirit cannot be broken, only bent.
introduction: I am Quanah Parker of the Comanche. The wind tells me you are a leader of your people. Let us speak as leaders should — with honesty and with respect.
neutralHello: The sun rises over the plains once more. What brings you to my camp?
hateHello: You again. The sight of you sours the morning like spoiled meat. Speak quickly and be gone.
tradeRequest: My people have goods to offer — hides, horses, and the fruits of the plains. Let us trade fairly, as honorable people do.

name: Spain
startIntroPart1: Welcome to Spain — a nation forged through centuries of conquest, exploration, and cultural brilliance. From the Roman legions that marched across our soil to the golden age of the Habsburgs, when the sun never set upon our dominions, the Spanish story is written in stone, in song, and in the blood of those who refused to kneel.
startIntroPart2: As we chart a new course through these turbulent waters, Spain stands ready — proud of her past, steadfast in her present, and hopeful for the dawn that lies beyond the horizon. The Iberian Peninsula has weathered empires, invasions, and the long shadow of civil strife. Whatever trials await, we shall meet them as Spaniards have always done: with fire in the chest and defiance in the eye.
declaringWar: Spain has endured invasions, civil wars, and empires that crumbled to dust before her gates. You will be no different. The drums of war echo through our valleys once more — may God have mercy on your cause, for Spain shall not.
attacked: So you strike at the heart of the Iberian Peninsula? You will find that Spanish blood does not run cold. Every inch of our soil has been paid for in sacrifice and remembrance, and we shall not yield it to the likes of you.
defeated: Spain… broken, yet unbowed. The banners may fall, the cities may burn, but the spirit of our people endures beyond the reach of any conqueror. History will remember what was done here — and history, as you shall learn, has a very long memory.
introduction: Greetings, friend. I am Pedro Sánchez, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Spain. Our nation carries the weight of a magnificent and complicated history upon her shoulders — triumphs and regrets alike. I trust you will prove to be a worthy partner in the chapters yet unwritten.
neutralHello: Spain welcomes you. Let us speak as civilized peoples should — with respect, with candor, and perhaps a glass of Rioja if the hour permits.
hateHello: Your presence is an insult to the dignity of Spain. Speak quickly and choose your words with care, for my patience grows thinner by the moment.
tradeRequest: Spain proposes an exchange that would benefit both our peoples. Trade has always been the lifeblood of great nations — from the galleons that crossed the Atlantic to the modern arteries of European commerce. Let us not squander the opportunity before us.

name: Sumeria
startIntroPart1: I am Gilgamesh, king of Uruk, the city of great walls and towering temples. Two-thirds god, one-third man, I have seen all things, experienced all things, and carved my story into stone for all eternity. No kingdom before mine rivaled its splendor, and no king before me commanded such devotion.
startIntroPart2: The ziggurats of my people rise toward the heavens, and the Euphrates flows with the bounty of the gods. Walk with me, friend, and let us build something worthy of remembrance — or stand against me and learn why even the gods whispered my name with caution.
declaringWar: You have strayed far from the path of wisdom, and now the Bull of Heaven shall trample your cities. I have slain monsters that would make your bravest warriors weep. Uruk marches — pray to whatever gods will still listen.
attacked: So you come at me with blade drawn? I wrestled the wild man Enkidu and made him my brother. I struck down Humbaba in the Cedar Forest where no man dared tread. You think you are the first to test me? Come then — come and be forgotten.
defeated: The walls of Uruk... they stood for a thousand years and more. I sought immortality and found only the truth that all things return to clay. My name was carved in stone, and stone endures. Remember me — for even in defeat, Gilgamesh does not truly fall.
introduction: Greetings, traveler. I am Gilgamesh, king of Uruk, he who saw the deep, the foundation of the land. Few have earned my respect, and fewer still my friendship. Which shall you pursue?
neutralHello: Ah, you return. Come, sit. The beer of Mesopotamia is the finest in the known world, and no man drinks alone in my hall. Speak — what brings you to my gates?
hateHello: You again. Every time I think the day cannot darken further, there you are. Speak quickly and begone — my patience wears thinner than a reed basket.
tradeRequest: The merchants of Uruk are without equal, and our granaries overflow. I offer you this — a fair bargain, as between equals. Do not insult me with haggling; I am a king, not a street vendor.

name: Switzerland
startIntroPart1: Welcome to the Swiss Confederation — a nation carved into the very bones of the Alps, where every valley holds a voice and every canton casts its vote. For centuries we have stood at the crossroads of Europe, neither conquered nor conqueror, a mosaic of tongues and traditions bound together by an unshakable devotion to liberty, self-determination, and mutual respect.
startIntroPart2: Our mountains have been our fortress, our neutrality our shield, and our direct democracy our compass. The road ahead is steep and the winds of history are unpredictable, but the Swiss have never feared the climb. Tell me — what summit shall we reach for together?
declaringWar: Switzerland has cherished peace above all else, but we are no strangers to the defense of what is ours. The Federal Council has deliberated, and the cantons have spoken. We will not watch our sovereignty trampled in silence — steel meets steel, and the Alps do not yield.
attacked: So you raise your hand against the Confederation? You will find that our peaks are as stubborn as our people and our resolve as deep as the lakes below them. We did not seek this fire, but we will not flee from it.
defeated: The mountains remain when empires crumble. Switzerland has endured invasions, schisms, and centuries of turmoil far darker than this hour. Lower our flag if you must — but know that the spirit of the cantons cannot be occupied. It lives on.
introduction: Greetings, and welcome. I am Karin Keller-Sutter, President of the Swiss Confederation. We are a people of many languages but one purpose: to build prosperity through partnership, not conquest. I trust we can find common ground between us.
neutralHello: Switzerland extends its warmest greetings. There is far more to be gained across a negotiating table than across a battlefield. Come, let us speak as neighbors.
hateHello: Diplomacy requires two willing partners. Your conduct has left Switzerland with little appetite for either conversation or trust. Speak quickly — and choose your words with care.
tradeRequest: Commerce has always been the quiet bridge between divided peoples. Switzerland has built its prosperity on fair exchange and open markets. I believe this arrangement serves us both — shall we shake on it?

name: Turkey
startIntroPart1: I am Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, President of the Republic of Türkiye. Our nation stands at the crossroads of two continents — heir to empires that shaped the very course of history, from the steppes of Central Asia to the gates of Vienna.
startIntroPart2: The Turkish people have endured centuries of storm and conquest, adaptation and rebirth. We are a nation that does not kneel. Walk with us as equals, and perhaps we shall build something worthy of our ancestors. Stand against us, and you will learn why they call this land the graveyard of empires.
declaringWar: You have pushed and pushed, and now you act surprised that the wall pushes back. Every door of dialogue was opened to you, and you slammed each one shut. The Turkish nation will not be humiliated by those who mistake patience for weakness. Prepare yourself — the storm comes.
attacked: So this is how you repay those who extended their hand in friendship? You strike at us in the night like common thieves and call it strategy. History will record your treachery in ink, and Türkiye will remember it far longer than you would like. You will regret this.
defeated: The Republic endures even as I fall. The spirit of Atatürk lives on in every Turkish heart, in every mountain and river of this land. You may take our cities, you may burn our banners — but you will never take our pride, our language, our soul. Türkiye does not die. It waits.
introduction: Welcome, traveler. I am Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, leader of the Turkish nation. Come — let us speak as equals beneath the shadow of two continents. There is much to discuss, and I have never been one to waste time on pleasantries when there is real work to be done.
neutralHello: Good to see you. Come, sit — let us discuss matters of mutual interest over a glass of çay. In Türkiye, we believe that no important decision should be made without first sharing a drink and a conversation.
hateHello: You again. I trust you have a reason for darkening my door, because my patience with you has worn thin enough to see through. Speak quickly — and choose your words with more care than you have chosen your actions.
tradeRequest: Türkiye sits at the bridge of East and West, and our markets reflect the wealth of both worlds. I believe we can come to an arrangement that serves us both — because a good deal, like a good bridge, must hold weight from both sides. What say you?

name: Ukraine
startIntroPart1: From the sweeping steppes of the north to the sun-warmed shores of the Black Sea, the Ukrainian people have endured centuries of conquest, famine, and subjugation — yet they remain unbroken. Their chornozem, the richest black soil on earth, has fed empires and nurtured a culture of song, faith, and fierce independence.
startIntroPart2: Volodymyr Zelenskyy, the nation turns to you in its hour of need. Will you steer Ukraine through the tempest and into the light? Will you build a civilization that refuses to kneel — one whose story will be told for a thousand years?
declaringWar: We did not seek this path, but we will walk it without flinching. Ukraine remembers every wound it has ever received, and it will not suffer another in silence. This is our answer.
attacked: So the mask falls at last. You mistake our patience for cowardice — the gravest error you will ever make. Ukraine has endured storms that would have shattered lesser nations. We will not bow, not now, not ever.
defeated: We fought not because victory was promised, but because surrender was never an option. The wheat fields will remember us. The rivers will remember us. Ukraine does not perish — she endures, she waits, she rises again. History will not forget what you have done here.
introduction: Greetings, friend. I am Volodymyr Zelenskyy, president of Ukraine — a nation carved from resilience and held together by hope. Come, let us speak as neighbors, not as enemies.
neutralHello: Good to see you. There is much our peoples could build together — shall we talk?
hateHello: I see you now, plainly, without illusion. No amount of words will conceal what you are. Speak quickly — I have little patience left.
tradeRequest: A fair exchange strengthens both our nations. Let us reason together — what do you say?

name: North Vietnam
startIntroPart1: For a thousand years, foreign boots have trampled the soil of Vietnam — Chinese mandarins, French legionnaires, Japanese occupiers — and for a thousand years, the Vietnamese people have risen to cast them out. From the jade waters of the Red River Delta to the mist-cloaked peaks of the Annamite Cordillera, the descendants of the Lạc Việt have bled, endured, and refused to kneel.
startIntroPart2: Hồ Chí Minh, Uncle to your people and revolutionary of the people's will, you have carried the torch of independence through colonial dungeons, jungle camps, and the smoke of a divided nation. The Democratic Republic of Vietnam stands upon the ashes of empire, forged in struggle and tempered by sacrifice. Will you reunite the nation, drive out the invaders, and lead Vietnam to the dawn of true sovereignty? The jungle watches. The rivers remember. Your people await.
declaringWar: We have stretched our hand toward peace until it trembled, but you mistook patience for cowardice. The Vietnamese people did not fight a thousand years of occupation to surrender now. If you wish to swallow our country, you will choke on it. This is our answer.
attacked: So the eagle swoops down upon the tiger. You are not the first to come with fire and steel, and you will not be the last to regret it. Every village you burn becomes a fortress, every field you poison becomes a grave for your soldiers. We welcome your aggression — it only sharpens our resolve.
defeated: You may occupy our cities, burn our forests, and scatter our bones across the land — but you will never conquer the soul of Vietnam. I go to my ancestors with a quiet heart, knowing that this people will rise again, as they have always risen. Write your history as you wish. The truth belongs to those who remain.
introduction: Greetings, friend. I am Hồ Chí Minh — a simple man who serves a simple people. Vietnam has known much suffering, yet we extend our hand in fellowship rather than in fear. Tell me, does your heart beat for peace, or does it hunger for conquest? Choose wisely, for the jungle has a long memory.
neutralHello: Welcome. The lotus blooms even in muddy waters. What brings you to Vietnam today?
hateHello: Your presence poisons the air like defoliant on a green field. Speak quickly, and do not waste what little patience I have left.
tradeRequest: Trade between our peoples should flow like the monsoon rain — nourishing when it falls equally upon both fields. I offer this exchange in the spirit of mutual benefit. What say you?
